DAILY CHALLENGES

Offline local challenges · Earn bonus credits
Same date gives the same three challenges offline. Complete them at your own pace in any mode.
All Modes & Valley Side Jobs

A. Free Roam

Open valley with 7 hidden engine parts, 6 side-mission beacons, 5 sculpted ramps, 3 speed traps, and AI MX riders.

B. Park Patrol Chase (Heat 1–5)

Longer tag-style pursuits with escalating Heat 1–5, reinforcements, and Heat 3+ roadblocks. Break sight or hit a Safe Zone.

C. Time Trials

Beat Bronze, Silver, and Gold times with live checkpoint split deltas and a live Pacer / Personal-Best Ghost bike.

D. Ghost Run (Playable From Start)

Stealth courier missions past searchlight drones & roadblocks. Tap F to coast silently or fit the hidden Silent Muffler!

E. Slope Summit — Hill-Climb

Attack the 42m Quarry Peak! Lean forward (C) and tap G Clutch-Kick to stay in the powerband.

F. Free-Roam Side Missions (6)

Find glowing violet beacons in Free Roam or launch any side job straight from here to earn extra credits.
